class.name: NetwBitBufferReader
class.brief_description: Serves bits and bytes back from a [PackedByteArray] in the order [NetwBitBufferWriter] wrote them.

method.name: align
method.description: Discards the leftover bits of the current byte so the next read is byte-aligned. The leftover is always under 8 bits, so the byte cursor is already at the next boundary.

method.name: create
method.description: Returns a reader positioned at the start of [param bytes]. Prefer this over [code]new()[/code], which yields a reader over no bytes at all.

method.name: get_aligned_bytes
method.description: Aligns, then reads [param count] raw bytes. A read past the end returns what remains.

method.name: get_aligned_u16
method.description: Aligns, then reads a 16-bit little-endian value.

method.name: get_aligned_u32
method.description: Aligns, then reads a 32-bit little-endian value.

method.name: get_bits
method.description: Reads [param count] bits, LSB-first. A [param count] of zero or less returns zero and consumes nothing.

method.name: remaining_bytes
method.description: Aligns, then returns how many unread bytes remain.

method.name: reset
method.description: Points this reader at [param bytes] from the start, so one reader can decode a second packet without a fresh allocation.
